profile.name: Elena
profile.title: Director of Data & Analytics
profile.description: I am a down-to-earth Data & Analytics Director driven by a genuine passion for solving complex problems, regardless of the technology or information available. I consider myself a pragmatic builder who bridges the gap between high-level strategy and technical execution across the entire data lifecycle. I thrive on the challenge of wearing multiple hats—fluidly operating as an analyst, scientist, engineer, architect, team lead, or project manager all at once—and I love it. This end-to-end immersion is exactly what gives me the deep technical credibility and operational weight required to steer department-wide technology and data strategies. My track record spans from establishing robust data governance and high-scale warehousing to deploying machine learning and near-real-time streaming pipelines. While I enjoy the capabilities of advanced data architectures, my focus is always on maximizing efficiency and business value. As a leader, I feel genuinely proud seeing the growth and progression of my team. My leadership focuses on driving operational efficiency and scalability through best practices, while fiercely protecting a safe, high-trust environment where people can elevate both their technical and soft skills. I deeply cherish knowledge sharing and aspire to keep learning with every role I take on, constantly expanding my expertise well beyond my own field.

challenges.description:
* Team Leadership & Delivery: Led an 8-person multidisciplinary team across 3 concurrent analytics projects (primarily for a major banking client), drastically reducing time-to-market while adhering strictly to bank regulations and architectural guidelines.
Directed the deployment of analytical workloads and near-real-time fraud prevention rules within the bank's enterprise Big Data ecosystem, leveraging Spark Streaming, ODI, and BDA.

* Fraud Mitigation & Code Refactoring: Developed models and rules to prevent fraud, and completely rewrote third-party algorithms to optimize performance and meet strict corporate best practices for production.

● Advanced Recommendation Engine: Engineered a complex recommendation engine using PySpark and Impala, integrating qualitative scoring and business prioritization, using Tableau for performance tracking.

● High-Scale ETL & Data Transformation: Built advanced PySpark and SQL pipelines to automate the parsing, cleaning, and modelling of massive log data, designing a data model optimized to process over 1.500 million rows per day.

● Advanced analytics: Developed a text mining workflow to automatically classify unstructured call centre records. Integrated these extracted insights with structured internal data to build a predictive customer churn model. Executed technical validations to demonstrate the scale, processing power, and architectural capabilities of IBM’s Big Data ecosystem for a financial institution.

● Cross-Sector Consulting & Client Delivery: Adapted rapidly to diverse environments by delivering analytics projects across multiple industries, presenting technical results directly to corporate clients.

manfredSpecificData.desiredJobDescription:
I’m looking for a hands-on leadership role where I can lead a team while staying deeply involved in the code. My goal is to solve complex business problems.
I work best in fast-paced environments where the focus is on clear, effective decision-making rather than process for the sake of process. My priority is to mentor my team, improve our analytical standards, and make sure our output actually changes how the business operates. I’m interested in exploring how to use AI to make our development cycles more efficient, but my real focus is on solving the actual problems.
